game.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare
game.blurb: Military first-person shooter from Raven Software, Activision, Infinity Ward, Beenox and High Moon Studios (as RAWG lists them), released 2019-10-25. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 2000950 is listed on the store as "Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare®" with no numeral, and its 27 achievements name campaign missions and characters (Piccadilly, Embedded, Clean House, The Wolf's Den, Barkov, Hadir), so it was taken as this game; please confirm it is not a later re-release. RAWG and StrategyWiki both date this title 2019. RAWG's first search result matched the expected slug (call-of-duty-modern-warfare). None of the 27 achievements is hidden, and none covers multiplayer; the only non-campaign one is "Liberation" (all Special Operations missions, 1.8%). StrategyWiki redirects "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare (2019)" to "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare" (completion stage 0, marked as a stub, category 2019); its Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents subpages are linked but not written, so nothing was used. callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare (2019)" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. Mission names in the chapter summary come from the achievement descriptions and are in Steam list order, which may not be play order.
